text:
sophie: Heads up — ACME SRE asked about private VPC POC pricing. They want platform fee waived for the POC (90 days) and a temporary downgrade to Gold support during evaluation. Can we move on this?
raj: What blockers on the tech side? do they need KMS/HSM in the POC?
olivia: KMS not required to start. They want to validate performance first. main blocker is the internal security questionnaire; we can scope the POC to non-prod data to avoid HSM for now.
maria: Legal — if we waive platform fee we need explicit SOW language limiting liability and a clean rollback clause. also need customer acknowledgement of non-prod data.
danny: Finance — what's the ARR tradeoff? need to model the net present value if we waive first-year platform fee. do we ask for a post-POC commit?
olivia: Proposal to customer (draft):
```
POC terms:
- Duration: 90 days
- Platform fee: WAIVED for POC (applies to first 3 months, up to 3 dedicated hosts)
- Support: Gold tier for POC (4h response)
- Post-POC: if customer signs 12m commit within 60 days -> apply 20% platform fee credit for first year
- Security: POC limited to non-PHI/non-PII data; full KMS/HSM integration on paid contract
```
sophie: Love it. Quick note: standard platform fee is $18k/mo for this config. waiving 3 months is ~$54k of list. recommend we ask for a $150k minimum ARR commit to justify the waiver.
danny: If commit >= $150k ARR, 20% credit year1 nets ~ $43k off list — acceptable. need Deal Desk approval for any platform fee waiver > $25k GAAP impact.
maria: Also need to add a clause: "Customer responsible for security questionnaire delays; Redwood not liable for schedule slip from delays."
raj: from SE: we'll provide a lightweight runbook and a perf dashboard snapshot during POC. we can limit tokens/requests to avoid noisy usage.
olivia: I'll send the SOW draft to legal and the customer. can we get Deal Desk to approve the waiver conditioned on: 1) non-prod data only, 2) commit >= $150k ARR within 60d, 3) SOW & rollback clause signed?
sophie: @deal-desk — requesting approval: waive platform fee for 90-day POC up to 3 hosts (~$54k list), conditional on 12m commit >= $150k ARR within 60 days post-POC, and Gold support for POC. Legal to finalize SOW language.
deal-desk: Thanks @sophie — please capture final numbers in the Deal Desk form. we need: expected ARR, GAAP impact, customer legal name, and signature timeline. provisional approval granted pending finance signoff. :white_check_mark:
maria: I'll review the SOW tonight and post comments. can someone add the security questionnaire link?
olivia: here: https://internal.company/q/security/acme-poc (customer already started, 12/25 questions completed).
raj: I'll prep the POC infra playbook and tag eng-oncall for the first 2 weeks.
danny: Finance — I'll run NPV quickly and put numbers in the deal form. if ARR forecast <150k we should push for a partial platform fee (50% during POC) instead of full waiver.
sophie: Thanks team. next actions: olivia finalize SOW + submit to Deal Desk form, danny run NPV, maria finalize legal clauses, raj ready infra plan. ping back here when submitted. :raised_hands:
